## 0.1 TextGrid reader and label conventions

The TextGrid reader is the one used in the earlier analysis (it handles Praat's UTF-16 files with a byte-order mark).

```{r tg-functions}
read_tg_lines <- function(path) {
  raw <- readBin(path, what = "raw", n = file.info(path)$size)
  if (length(raw) >= 2 && raw[1] == as.raw(0xFF) && raw[2] == as.raw(0xFE)) {
    txt <- iconv(list(raw[-(1:2)]), from = "UTF-16LE", to = "UTF-8")
  } else if (length(raw) >= 2 && raw[1] == as.raw(0xFE) && raw[2] == as.raw(0xFF)) {
    txt <- iconv(list(raw[-(1:2)]), from = "UTF-16BE", to = "UTF-8")
  } else {
    if (length(raw) >= 3 && all(raw[1:3] == as.raw(c(0xEF, 0xBB, 0xBF)))) raw <- raw[-(1:3)]
    txt <- rawToChar(raw)
    Encoding(txt) <- "UTF-8"
  }
  if (is.na(txt)) stop("Could not decode TextGrid: ", path)
  strsplit(txt, "\r\n|\n|\r")[[1]]
}

parse_textgrid <- function(path) {
  L <- trimws(read_tg_lines(path))
  starts <- grep("^item \\[[0-9]+\\]:", L)
  if (length(starts) == 0) stop("Not a long-format TextGrid (save as 'full text'): ", path)
  ends <- c(starts[-1] - 1, length(L))
  purrr::map2_dfr(starts, ends, function(s, e) {
    blk <- L[s:e]
    cls <- sub('^class = "(.*)"$', "\\1", blk[grep("^class = ", blk)[1]])
    nm  <- sub('^name = "(.*)"$',  "\\1", blk[grep("^name = ",  blk)[1]])
    if (!identical(cls, "IntervalTier")) return(NULL)
    ii <- grep("^intervals \\[[0-9]+\\]:", blk)
    if (length(ii) == 0) return(NULL)
    tibble(tier = nm,
           xmin = as.numeric(sub("^xmin = ", "", blk[ii + 1])),
           xmax = as.numeric(sub("^xmax = ", "", blk[ii + 2])),
           text = gsub('""', '"', sub('^text = "(.*)"\\s*$', "\\1", blk[ii + 3])))
  })
}
```

```{r labels}
ARPA <- c(AA = "ɑ", AE = "æ", AH = "ʌ", AO = "ɔ", AW = "aw", AY = "aj", EH = "ɛ", ER = "ɜ", EY = "ej",
          IH = "ɪ", IY = "i", OW = "ow", OY = "ɔj", UH = "ʊ", UW = "u", AX = "ə")
canon_label <- function(x) {
  x <- str_trim(x)
  base <- str_remove(x, "[0-2]$")
  ifelse(!is.na(x) & str_detect(x, "^[A-Z]{2}[0-2]?$") & base %in% names(ARPA), unname(ARPA[base]), x)
}
vowel_re <- "^[aeiouyɑæɐɘəɚɛɜɝɞɨɪɔɵøɤɯʉʊʌʏœɶɒ]"
DIPH    <- c("aj", "aw", "ɔj", "ej", "ow", "əw", "ɑj", "ɑw", "aɪ", "aʊ", "ɔɪ", "eɪ", "oʊ", "əʊ",
             "ou", "ei", "ai", "au", "oi", "ɔi", "eə", "ɛə", "ɪə", "ʊə")
FRONT   <- c("i", "iː", "ɪ", "ɪː", "e", "eː", "ɛ", "ɛː", "æ", "a", "aː")
CENTRAL <- c("ɜ", "ɜː", "ə", "ʌ", "ɐ", "ɚ", "ɝ")
BACK    <- c("u", "uː", "ʊ", "o", "oː", "ɔ", "ɔː", "ɑ", "ɒ")
is_vowel <- function(x) str_detect(x, vowel_re) & (cfg$diph_as_vowel | !(x %in% DIPH))
category <- function(x) case_when(x %in% DIPH ~ "Diphthong", x %in% FRONT ~ "Front", x %in% CENTRAL ~ "Central",
                                  x %in% BACK ~ "Back", TRUE ~ "Other")
nucleus  <- function(x) ifelse(x %in% DIPH, str_sub(x, 1, 1), x)   # first element of a diphthong

tg_cache <- new.env()
read_phones <- function(cond, rec) {
  key <- paste(cond, rec, sep = "||")
  if (!is.null(tg_cache[[key]])) return(tg_cache[[key]])
  pt <- unname(part_of[rec]); if (length(pt) == 0 || is.na(pt)) pt <- "round1"
  f <- file.path(part_root(pt), cond, paste0(rec, ".TextGrid"))
  out <- tibble(start = numeric(), end = numeric(), label = character())
  if (file.exists(f)) {
    ph <- parse_textgrid(f) %>% filter(str_detect(tolower(tier), "phone"))
    if (nrow(ph) > 0) out <- ph %>% transmute(start = xmin, end = xmax, label = canon_label(text))
  }
  assign(key, out, envir = tg_cache)
  out
}

# best-overlapping candidate for each query interval; it must cover at least half of the shorter of the two
match_best <- function(qs, qe, cs, ce) {
  if (length(qs) == 0 || length(cs) == 0) return(rep(NA_integer_, length(qs)))
  ov <- outer(qe, ce, pmin) - outer(qs, cs, pmax)
  ov[ov < 0] <- 0                                  # (pmax(0, ov) would drop the matrix dimensions)
  j <- max.col(ov, ties.method = "first")
  best <- ov[cbind(seq_along(qs), j)]
  shorter <- pmin(qe - qs, ce[j] - cs[j])
  ifelse(best > 0 & best >= 0.5 * shorter, j, NA_integer_)
}
```

## 1.2 MFA alignment output (Table 2)

```{r table2}
read_align <- function(cd) {
  fs <- c(p("alignment_info", paste0(cd, "_alignment_analysis.csv")), p("extension", "alignment_info", paste0(cd, "_alignment_analysis.csv")))
  fs <- fs[file.exists(fs)]
  if (length(fs) == 0) stop("Missing alignment_analysis csv for ", cd)
  map_dfr(fs, function(f) read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE) %>%
    transmute(cond = cd, file = tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(as.character(file))),
              ll  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(overall_log_likelihood)),
              snr = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(snr)),
              dd  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(phone_duration_deviation)))) %>%
    group_by(cond, file) %>%
    summarise(across(c(ll, snr, dd), ~ if (all(is.na(.x))) NA_real_ else mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")
}
align_all <- map_dfr(cfg$conds, read_align)
align_shared <- align_all %>% filter(file %in% shared)

summ_align <- function(d) d %>% group_by(cond) %>%
  summarise(recordings = sum(!is.na(snr)),
            ll_mean = mean(ll, na.rm = TRUE),  ll_sd = sd_pop(ll[!is.na(ll)]),
            snr_mean = mean(snr, na.rm = TRUE), snr_sd = sd_pop(snr[!is.na(snr)]), snr_min = min(snr, na.rm = TRUE),
            at_or_below_3dB = sum(snr <= cfg$low_snr_db, na.rm = TRUE),
            dd_mean = mean(dd, na.rm = TRUE), dd_sd = sd_pop(dd[!is.na(dd)]), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(cond = factor(cond, levels = cfg$conds)) %>% arrange(cond)
table2    <- summ_align(align_shared)                                   # the whole corpus
table2_r1 <- summ_align(align_shared %>% filter(file %in% study_shared))  # round 1 only: kept as a regression check
kable(table2, digits = 2, caption = "Table 2. MFA alignment output on the recordings aligned by all four dictionaries (mean and SD over recordings)")
write_csv(table2, file.path(out_dir, "table2_alignment_output.csv"))
```

# 2. Reference annotation (Section 2.3)

The 396 tokens were drawn once, from the NigE alignment, by `draw_blind_sample_v2.py` (seed 2027) and are read here from the key file. Annotations are the Praat output files; Praat writes an empty cell as `?`, which is treated as missing. When the same token appears in several files (the re-annotation file `batch_9`), the last file wins.

```{r annotations}
read_ann <- function(dir) {
  files <- sort(list.files(dir, "^batch_.*_annotated\\.tsv$", full.names = TRUE))
  stopifnot(length(files) > 0)
  d <- map_dfr(files, function(f) read_tsv(f, col_types = cols(.default = col_character()), progress = FALSE) %>%
                 mutate(src = basename(f)))
  d <- d %>% mutate(across(-src, ~ ifelse(str_trim(.x) %in% c("?", "--undefined--"), NA_character_, .x)))
  d %>% group_by(id) %>% slice_tail(n = 1) %>% ungroup()
}
ann <- read_ann(cfg$ann_dir)
key <- read_csv(p("blind_sample_v2", "blind_sample_KEY_do_not_open.csv"),
                col_types = cols(.default = col_character())) %>%
  mutate(nurse_token = as.integer(nurse_token))

ann_status <- ann %>%
  mutate(status = case_when(is.na(label) ~ "not annotated", label == "UNSURE" ~ "cannot judge",
                            is.na(onset_s) | is.na(offset_s) ~ "no valid mark", TRUE ~ "usable")) %>%
  count(status)
kable(ann_status, caption = "Status of the drawn tokens")
add_check("Tokens drawn", nrow(key), 396, 0)

toks <- ann %>%
  transmute(id, file, word, lab = canon_label(str_trim(label)), on = as.numeric(onset_s), off = as.numeric(offset_s)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(lab), lab != "UNSURE", !is.na(on), !is.na(off)) %>%
  left_join(key %>% select(id, nurse = nurse_token, nige_label), by = "id") %>%
  mutate(nurse = coalesce(nurse, 0L)) %>% arrange(id)
cat("Usable annotated tokens:", nrow(toks), "from", n_distinct(toks$file), "recordings;",
    "tokens outside the shared recordings:", sum(!toks$file %in% shared), "\n")
add_check("Usable annotated tokens", nrow(toks), 308, 0)
add_check("Recordings with a usable token", n_distinct(toks$file), 63, 0)
tok_ids   <- toks$id
tok_files <- toks$file
```

```{r sample-composition}
# tokens per NigE label, drawn and usable (the editor asked for about 30 per category)
comp <- key %>% filter(nurse_token == 0) %>% count(nige_label, name = "drawn") %>%
  left_join(toks %>% filter(nurse == 0) %>% count(nige_label, name = "usable"), by = "nige_label") %>%
  mutate(usable = coalesce(usable, 0L))
kable(comp, caption = "Tokens per NigE vowel label: drawn and usable")
cat("NURSE tokens drawn:", sum(key$nurse_token == 1), "| usable:", sum(toks$nurse == 1), "\n")
add_check("NURSE tokens usable", sum(toks$nurse == 1), 31, 0)

# phonetic context coverage of the drawn tokens (preceding and following class, from the key)
if (all(c("preceding", "following") %in% names(key))) {
  ctx <- key %>% filter(nurse_token == 0) %>% group_by(nige_label) %>%
    summarise(preceding_classes = n_distinct(preceding), following_classes = n_distinct(following), .groups = "drop")
  print(kable(ctx, caption = "Number of distinct preceding and following context classes per vowel (drawn tokens)"))
}

# vowel-numbering correction (the first draw did not count diphthongs when numbering the vowels of a word)
numchk <- p("blind_sample_v2", "vowel_numbering_check.csv")
if (file.exists(numchk)) {
  nc <- read_csv(numchk, show_col_types = FALSE)
  cat("Tokens whose vowel number changed:", sum(nc$changed == 1), "of", nrow(nc), "\n")
  add_check("Tokens with a corrected vowel number", sum(nc$changed == 1), 11, 0)
}
```

# 3. Scoring against the four dictionaries (Section 3.1 to 3.3)

Each annotated vowel is compared with the vowel intervals of each alignment. With `match_rule = "overlap"`, a dictionary finds the vowel when one of its vowel intervals overlaps the annotated vowel by at least half of the shorter of the two. With `"midpoint"`, the midpoint of the annotated vowel must fall inside a vowel interval. Labels are compared at three levels (same symbol; same symbol ignoring length; same category).

```{r score}
score_one <- function(cond, rec, on, off, lab) {
  ph  <- read_phones(cond, rec)
  mid <- (on + off) / 2
  idx <- which(ph$start <= mid & mid < ph$end)[1]          # interval under the midpoint of the annotated vowel
  at_lab <- NA_character_; hit_lab <- NA_character_; hit_s <- NA_real_; hit_e <- NA_real_; det <- FALSE
  if (!is.na(idx)) {
    at_lab <- hit_lab <- ph$label[idx]; hit_s <- ph$start[idx]; hit_e <- ph$end[idx]
    det <- is_vowel(hit_lab) && (hit_e - hit_s) > 0
  }
  if (cfg$match_rule == "overlap") {
    det <- FALSE
    v <- which(is_vowel(ph$label) & ph$end > ph$start)
    if (length(v) > 0) {
      ov <- pmax(0, pmin(off, ph$end[v]) - pmax(on, ph$start[v]))
      j <- which.max(ov); b <- v[j]
      if (ov[j] >= 0.5 * min(off - on, ph$end[b] - ph$start[b])) {
        det <- TRUE; hit_lab <- ph$label[b]; hit_s <- ph$start[b]; hit_e <- ph$end[b]
      }
    }
  }
  m <- if (det) hit_lab else NA_character_
  model <- if (det) hit_lab else if (is.na(at_lab)) "(none)" else paste0("(", ifelse(at_lab == "", "silence", at_lab), ")")
  tibble(detected  = as.integer(det), model = model,
         strict    = as.integer(det && m == lab),
         nolen     = as.integer(det && sub("ː+$", "", m) == sub("ː+$", "", lab)),
         cat       = as.integer(det && category(m) == category(lab)),
         mono2diph = as.integer(det && m %in% DIPH && !(lab %in% DIPH)),
         on_err    = if (det) (hit_s - on) * 1000 else NA_real_,
         off_err   = if (det) (hit_e - off) * 1000 else NA_real_)
}

scored <- tidyr::expand_grid(toks, cond = cfg$conds) %>%
  mutate(res = pmap(list(cond, file, on, off, lab), score_one)) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(res) %>%
  mutate(etype = case_when(detected == 0 ~ "M", cat == 0 ~ "S", strict == 0 ~ "D", TRUE ~ "A"),
         dur_diff = off_err - on_err)
cat("Scored rows:", nrow(scored), "(tokens x dictionaries)\n")
write_csv(scored, file.path(out_dir, "token_level_scores_R.csv"))

metric_vec <- function(cd, col) { d <- scored[scored$cond == cd, ]; d <- d[match(tok_ids, d$id), ]; d[[col]] }
```

## 3.1 Agreement with the annotator (Table 3) and paired differences

Intervals come from a bootstrap over recordings (all tokens of a recording are resampled together).

```{r bootstrap}
set.seed(2028)
idx_by_file <- split(seq_along(tok_files), tok_files)
boot_list <- replicate(cfg$B, unlist(idx_by_file[sample(names(idx_by_file), replace = TRUE)], use.names = FALSE),
                       simplify = FALSE)
ci_pct <- function(x) {
  bs <- vapply(boot_list, function(i) mean(x[i]), numeric(1)) * 100
  c(est = mean(x) * 100, lo = unname(quantile(bs, .025)), hi = unname(quantile(bs, .975)))
}
table3 <- map_dfr(cfg$conds, function(cd) {
  f <- ci_pct(metric_vec(cd, "detected")); s <- ci_pct(metric_vec(cd, "strict")); k <- ci_pct(metric_vec(cd, "cat"))
  tibble(dictionary = cd, n = length(tok_ids),
         found = f[["est"]], found_lo = f[["lo"]], found_hi = f[["hi"]],
         same_symbol = s[["est"]], same_symbol_lo = s[["lo"]], same_symbol_hi = s[["hi"]],
         same_symbol_no_length = mean(metric_vec(cd, "nolen")) * 100,
         same_category = k[["est"]], same_category_lo = k[["lo"]], same_category_hi = k[["hi"]],
         nf = 100 - k[["est"]], mono_to_diph = mean(metric_vec(cd, "mono2diph")) * 100)
})
kable(table3, digits = 1, caption = "Table 3. Agreement of each dictionary with the annotator")
write_csv(table3, file.path(out_dir, "table3_agreement.csv"))

paired <- map_dfr(c("detected", "strict", "nolen", "cat"), function(col) {
  map_dfr(cfg$conds[-1], function(cd) {
    d <- metric_vec("NigE", col) - metric_vec(cd, col)
    bs <- vapply(boot_list, function(i) mean(d[i]), numeric(1)) * 100
    tibble(measure = col, versus = cd, diff_points = mean(d) * 100, lo = unname(quantile(bs, .025)), hi = unname(quantile(bs, .975)))
  })
})
kable(paired, digits = 1, caption = "Paired difference, NigE minus the other dictionary (percentage points)")
write_csv(paired, file.path(out_dir, "paired_differences_vs_NigE.csv"))

for (cd in cfg$conds) {
  r <- table3[table3$dictionary == cd, ]
  add_check(paste("Found %,", cd), r$found, c(NigE = 93.5, Indian = 86.7, UK = 90.6, US = 89.0)[[cd]])
  add_check(paste("Same symbol %,", cd), r$same_symbol, c(NigE = 42.5, Indian = 13.6, UK = 13.6, US = 13.3)[[cd]])
  add_check(paste("Same symbol, length ignored %,", cd), r$same_symbol_no_length, c(NigE = 58.4, Indian = 31.2, UK = 24.0, US = 17.9)[[cd]])
  add_check(paste("Same category %,", cd), r$same_category, c(NigE = 77.3, Indian = 46.8, UK = 40.3, US = 41.6)[[cd]])
  add_check(paste("Monophthong returned as diphthong %,", cd), r$mono_to_diph, c(NigE = 1.0, Indian = 1.0, UK = 11.0, US = 11.4)[[cd]])
}
add_check("Paired category difference, NigE - UK", paired$diff_points[paired$measure == "cat" & paired$versus == "UK"], 37.0, 0.1)
```

Duration is compared only for vowels whose label matches the annotator's. Medians come from different sets of tokens in different dictionaries, so the dictionaries are also compared on the same tokens: vowels labelled correctly under both NigE and the other dictionary.

```{r duration}
dur_unpaired <- scored %>% filter(nolen == 1) %>% group_by(cond) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), median_diff_ms = median(dur_diff), q25 = unname(quantile(dur_diff, .25)), q75 = unname(quantile(dur_diff, .75)),
            pct_longer_20 = 100 * mean(dur_diff >= 20), pct_shorter_20 = 100 * mean(dur_diff <= -20), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(cond = factor(cond, levels = cfg$conds)) %>% arrange(cond)
kable(dur_unpaired, digits = 1, caption = "Aligned minus annotated duration, vowels with the same symbol (length ignored)")

dur_paired <- function(level) {
  a <- scored[scored$cond == "NigE", ]; a <- a[match(tok_ids, a$id), ]
  map_dfr(cfg$conds[-1], function(cd) {
    b <- scored[scored$cond == cd, ]; b <- b[match(tok_ids, b$id), ]
    ok <- a[[level]] == 1 & b[[level]] == 1 & a$detected == 1 & b$detected == 1
    d <- b$dur_diff - a$dur_diff
    bs <- vapply(boot_list, function(i) { j <- i[ok[i]]; if (length(j)) mean(d[j]) else NA_real_ }, numeric(1))
    tibble(level = level, versus = cd, n = sum(ok), mean_diff_ms = mean(d[ok]), median_diff_ms = median(d[ok]),
           lo = unname(quantile(bs, .025, na.rm = TRUE)), hi = unname(quantile(bs, .975, na.rm = TRUE)))
  })
}
dur_pair_tab <- bind_rows(dur_paired("nolen"), dur_paired("strict"), dur_paired("cat"))
kable(dur_pair_tab, digits = 1, caption = "Paired difference in aligned duration, dictionary minus NigE, tokens labelled correctly under both")
write_csv(dur_pair_tab, file.path(out_dir, "duration_paired.csv"))
add_check("Paired duration difference, Indian (same symbol, length ignored)", dur_pair_tab$mean_diff_ms[dur_pair_tab$level == "nolen" & dur_pair_tab$versus == "Indian"], 0.6, 0.2)
add_check("Paired duration difference, US (same symbol, length ignored)", dur_pair_tab$mean_diff_ms[dur_pair_tab$level == "nolen" & dur_pair_tab$versus == "US"], -2.1, 0.2)
```

# 4. Formants (Section 3.4)

`new-fave` writes one row every 2 ms for every vowel it tracked. A token is one vowel (one `id`). Midpoint F1 and F2 are the smoothed tracks (`F1_s`, `F2_s`) interpolated at 50% of the vowel; trajectories are the same tracks interpolated at 20 equal-duration bins. Tokens are every vowel that `new-fave` tracked (its own minimum is 50 ms of vowel duration); only tracks with fewer than five points or a span under `min_span` are dropped. Midpoints are Lobanov-normalised (z-scores) by recording and dictionary, for recordings with at least 30 tracked vowels.

```{r read-tracks}
cent <- (seq_len(cfg$n_bins) - 0.5) / cfg$n_bins
ap <- function(t, y, s, e, x0) {
  if (!is.finite(e - s) || e <= s) return(rep(NA_real_, length(x0)))
  approx((t - s) / (e - s), y, xout = x0, rule = 2, ties = mean)$y
}
read_tracks_dir <- function(dir, cond, keep) {
  files <- list.files(dir, "tracks\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
  nm <- basename(files)
  stems <- ifelse(str_detect(nm, "_tracks\\.csv$"), str_remove(nm, "_tracks\\.csv$"), str_remove(nm, "tracks\\.csv$"))
  sel <- stems %in% keep
  map2_dfr(files[sel], stems[sel], function(f, rec) {
    d <- read_csv(f, col_select = any_of(c("id", "label", "time", "F1", "F2", "F1_s", "F2_s")),
                  show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE)
    if (!"F1_s" %in% names(d)) d$F1_s <- NA_real_
    if (!"F2_s" %in% names(d)) d$F2_s <- NA_real_
    d <- d %>% mutate(f1 = coalesce(F1_s, F1), f2 = coalesce(F2_s, F2)) %>% filter(!is.na(time), !is.na(f1), !is.na(f2))
    if (nrow(d) == 0) return(NULL)
    d$id <- as.character(d$id)
    if (n_distinct(d$id) <= 2 && nrow(d) > 300) {      # id is not one per vowel: split on a label change or a gap in time
      d <- d %>% arrange(time) %>%
        mutate(id = paste0("tok", cumsum(label != lag(label, default = dplyr::first(label)) |
                                         (time - lag(time, default = dplyr::first(time))) > 0.01)))
    }
    d %>% group_by(id) %>% filter(n() >= 5) %>% arrange(time, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
      summarise(label = canon_label(dplyr::first(label)), start = min(time), end = max(time), span = end - start,
                f1_50 = ap(time, f1, start, end, 0.5)[1], f2_50 = ap(time, f2, start, end, 0.5)[1],
                t1 = list(ap(time, f1, start, end, cent)), t2 = list(ap(time, f2, start, end, cent)), .groups = "drop") %>%
      filter(span > 0) %>% mutate(cond = cond, rec = rec)
  })
}
read_tracks <- function(cond) {
  map_dfr(unique(corpus_map$part), function(pt) {
    d <- read_tracks_dir(file.path(part_root(pt), "fave_runs", cond), cond, corpus_map$rec[corpus_map$part == pt])
    if (nrow(d) > 0) d$part <- pt
    d
  })
}
tracks_all <- map_dfr(cfg$conds, read_tracks)
print(tracks_all %>% count(cond, name = "tokens") %>% as.data.frame())
tracks_by <- split(tracks_all, paste(tracks_all$cond, tracks_all$rec, sep = "||"))
get_tracks <- function(cd, rec) tracks_by[[paste(cd, rec, sep = "||")]]
```

## 4.1 Availability (Table 7)

```{r table7}
avail_one <- function(cd) {
  map_dfr(shared, function(rec) {
    iv <- read_phones(cd, rec) %>% filter(str_detect(label, vowel_re)) %>% mutate(dur = end - start)
    tk <- get_tracks(cd, rec)
    j <- if (is.null(tk) || nrow(iv) == 0) rep(NA_integer_, nrow(iv)) else match_best(iv$start, iv$end, tk$start, tk$end)
    iv %>% mutate(tracked = !is.na(j), rec = rec)
  }) %>% mutate(cond = cd)
}
iv_all <- map_dfr(cfg$conds, avail_one)
iv_all$part <- unname(part_of[iv_all$rec])
table7 <- iv_all %>% group_by(cond) %>%
  summarise(vowel_intervals = n(), ge50ms = sum(dur >= cfg$min_dur),
            tracked_ge50 = sum(tracked & dur >= cfg$min_dur), n_tracked = sum(tracked),
            pct_of_all = 100 * n_tracked / vowel_intervals,
            pct_of_ge50 = 100 * tracked_ge50 / ge50ms, .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(cond = factor(cond, levels = cfg$conds)) %>% arrange(cond)
kable(table7, digits = 1, caption = "Table 7. Formant availability by dictionary")
write_csv(table7, file.path(out_dir, "table7_formant_availability.csv"))
by_dur <- iv_all %>%
  mutate(bin = cut(dur, c(-Inf, .03, .05, .07, .10, Inf), right = FALSE,
                   labels = c("<30 ms", "30-50 ms", "50-70 ms", "70-100 ms", ">=100 ms"))) %>%
  group_by(cond, bin) %>% summarise(intervals = n(), tracked = sum(tracked), .groups = "drop")
kable(by_dur, caption = "Tracked intervals by interval duration")
table7_by_part <- iv_all %>% group_by(part, cond) %>%
  summarise(recordings = n_distinct(rec), vowel_intervals = n(), ge50ms = sum(dur >= cfg$min_dur), n_tracked = sum(tracked), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(cond = factor(cond, levels = cfg$conds)) %>% arrange(part, cond)
kable(table7_by_part, caption = "The same, by transcription round (the two rounds should behave alike)")
write_csv(table7_by_part, file.path(out_dir, "table7_by_round.csv"))
table7_r1 <- table7_by_part %>% filter(part == "round1")      # round 1 only: kept as a regression check
for (cd in cfg$conds) {
  r <- table7_r1[table7_r1$cond == cd, ]
  add_check(paste("Vowel intervals, round 1,", cd), r$vowel_intervals, c(NigE = 6819, Indian = 6661, UK = 6820, US = 6813)[[cd]], 0)
  add_check(paste("Tracked vowels, round 1,", cd), r$n_tracked, c(NigE = 5118, Indian = 4962, UK = 5128, US = 5028)[[cd]], 0)
}
```

## 4.2 Normalisation and the dictionary's effect on the measurement

```{r normalise}
zpar <- tracks_all %>% filter(span >= cfg$min_span) %>% group_by(cond, rec) %>% filter(n() >= cfg$min_tokens_norm) %>%
  summarise(m1 = mean(f1_50), s1 = sd_pop(f1_50), m2 = mean(f2_50), s2 = sd_pop(f2_50), .groups = "drop")
tracks_z <- tracks_all %>% filter(span >= cfg$min_span) %>% inner_join(zpar, by = c("cond", "rec")) %>%
  mutate(z1 = (f1_50 - m1) / s1, z2 = (f2_50 - m2) / s2)
cat("Recordings normalised per dictionary:\n"); print(zpar %>% count(cond) %>% as.data.frame())
cat("Tokens in the normalised set per dictionary:\n"); print(tracks_z %>% count(cond) %>% as.data.frame())
tz_by <- split(tracks_z, paste(tracks_z$cond, tracks_z$rec, sep = "||"))
# label-level summaries and figures use at most cap_per_rec vowels per recording and dictionary: long recordings (unscripted speeches)
# would otherwise decide where the categories lie
set.seed(2031)
tracks_z_cap <- tracks_z %>% group_by(cond, rec) %>% group_modify(~ dplyr::slice_sample(.x, n = min(cfg$cap_per_rec, nrow(.x)))) %>% ungroup()
cat("Tokens after the per-recording cap:\n"); print(tracks_z_cap %>% count(cond) %>% as.data.frame())
```

```{r stability}
# the same vowel under the NigE dictionary and another one: how different are the midpoint formants (Hz)?
stab <- map_dfr(cfg$conds[-1], function(cd) {
  map_dfr(shared, function(rec) {
    a <- get_tracks("NigE", rec); b <- get_tracks(cd, rec)
    if (is.null(a) || is.null(b)) return(NULL)
    a <- a %>% filter(span >= cfg$min_span); b <- b %>% filter(span >= cfg$min_span)
    if (nrow(a) == 0 || nrow(b) == 0) return(NULL)
    j <- match_best(a$start, a$end, b$start, b$end); ok <- !is.na(j)
    tibble(rec = rec, d1 = abs(a$f1_50[ok] - b$f1_50[j[ok]]), d2 = abs(a$f2_50[ok] - b$f2_50[j[ok]]))
  }) %>% mutate(cond = cd)
})
stab_tab <- stab %>% group_by(cond) %>%
  summarise(matched = n(), median_abs_dF1 = median(d1), p90_abs_dF1 = quantile(d1, .9),
            median_abs_dF2 = median(d2), p90_abs_dF2 = quantile(d2, .9), .groups = "drop")
kable(stab_tab, digits = 1, caption = "Midpoint formants of matched vowels, dictionary versus NigE (absolute difference, Hz)")
write_csv(stab_tab, file.path(out_dir, "stability_vs_NigE.csv"))
set.seed(2032)
stab_cap_tab <- stab %>% group_by(cond, rec) %>% group_modify(~ dplyr::slice_sample(.x, n = min(cfg$cap_per_rec, nrow(.x)))) %>% ungroup() %>% group_by(cond) %>%
  summarise(matched = n(), median_abs_dF1 = median(d1), p90_abs_dF1 = quantile(d1, .9),
            median_abs_dF2 = median(d2), p90_abs_dF2 = quantile(d2, .9), .groups = "drop")
kable(stab_cap_tab, digits = 1, caption = paste("The same, with at most", cfg$cap_per_rec, "matched vowels per recording (sensitivity)"))
```

## 4.3 Annotated vowels with formants, and how well each set of labels sorts them

```{r annotated-formants}
find_tok <- function(cd, rec, on, off) {
  none <- tibble(tlabel = NA_character_, z1 = NA_real_, z2 = NA_real_)
  tk <- tz_by[[paste(cd, rec, sep = "||")]]
  if (is.null(tk)) return(none)
  j <- match_best(on, off, tk$start, tk$end)
  if (is.na(j)) none else tibble(tlabel = tk$label[j], z1 = tk$z1[j], z2 = tk$z2[j])
}
tk_ann <- tidyr::expand_grid(toks %>% select(id, file, on, off, lab, nurse), cond = cfg$conds) %>%
  mutate(res = pmap(list(cond, file, on, off), find_tok)) %>% tidyr::unnest(res)
with_f <- tk_ann %>% group_by(cond) %>% summarise(annotated_with_formants = sum(!is.na(z1)), of = n(), .groups = "drop")
kable(with_f, caption = "Annotated vowels with formants, by dictionary")
S_ids <- tk_ann %>% filter(!is.na(z1)) %>% count(id) %>% filter(n == length(cfg$conds)) %>% pull(id)
cat("Annotated vowels with formants under all four dictionaries:", length(S_ids), "\n")
S <- tk_ann %>% filter(id %in% S_ids)

adj_r2 <- function(x, g) {
  n <- length(x); k <- n_distinct(g)
  if (n < 5 || k < 2) return(NA_real_)
  gm <- mean(x); sst <- sum((x - gm)^2)
  ssb <- sum(tapply(x, g, function(v) length(v) * (mean(v) - gm)^2))
  e <- ssb / sst
  1 - (1 - e) * (n - 1) / max(n - k, 1)
}
mean_z <- S %>% group_by(id) %>% summarise(lab = dplyr::first(lab), nurse = dplyr::first(nurse), z1 = mean(z1), z2 = mean(z2), .groups = "drop")
schemes <- bind_rows(
  mean_z %>% transmute(scheme = "Annotator", label = lab, nurse, z1, z2),   # the annotator's labels, on the mean of the four dictionaries' values
  S %>% transmute(scheme = cond, label = tlabel, nurse, z1, z2))
lab_var <- schemes %>% group_by(scheme) %>%
  summarise(categories = n_distinct(label), adj_R2_F1 = adj_r2(z1, label), adj_R2_F2 = adj_r2(z2, label), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(scheme = factor(scheme, levels = c("Annotator", cfg$conds))) %>% arrange(scheme)
kable(lab_var, digits = 2, caption = "Share of the variance in normalised F1 and F2 explained by the labels (adjusted R-squared), same tokens")
write_csv(lab_var, file.path(out_dir, "label_variance_explained.csv"))
```

## 4.4 Trajectories

Path length is the distance travelled through the normalised F1-F2 plane over bins 3 to 18 of the 20; net displacement is the distance between the first and last of those bins.

```{r trajectories}
path_stats <- function(t1, t2, m1, s1, m2, s2) {
  b <- 3:(cfg$n_bins - 2)
  x <- ((t1 - m1) / s1)[b]; y <- ((t2 - m2) / s2)[b]
  c(path = sum(sqrt(diff(x)^2 + diff(y)^2)), net = sqrt((x[length(x)] - x[1])^2 + (y[length(y)] - y[1])^2))
}
traj <- tracks_z_cap %>% mutate(ps = pmap(list(t1, t2, m1, s1, m2, s2), path_stats),
                            path = map_dbl(ps, 1), net = map_dbl(ps, 2)) %>% select(-ps)
traj_tab <- traj %>% group_by(cond, label) %>% filter(n() >= cfg$min_n_traj) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), median_path = median(path), median_net = median(net), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(cond = factor(cond, levels = cfg$conds)) %>% arrange(cond, desc(n))
kable(traj_tab %>% group_by(cond) %>% slice_head(n = 14), digits = 2, caption = "Median trajectory length by label (the 14 most frequent labels per dictionary)")
write_csv(traj_tab, file.path(out_dir, "trajectory_by_label.csv"))
```

## 4.6 Alignment success and agreement between dictionaries (whole corpus)

Every recording of the corpus is considered together. Alignment success asks whether a dictionary returns a TextGrid for a recording at all. Agreement between dictionaries needs no annotation: for every vowel interval of the NigE alignment, the vowel interval of another dictionary that overlaps it by at least half of the shorter one is its counterpart. It describes how far the dictionaries agree with each other, not which one is right. The two transcription rounds appear only in the tables that check that they behave alike.

```{r corpus-success}
rec_info <- rec_seconds %>%
  mutate(series = str_extract(rec, "^[A-Za-z]+"),
         words = map2_int(rec, part, function(r, pt) {
           f <- file.path(part_root(pt), "NigE", paste0(r, ".txt"))
           if (!file.exists(f)) return(NA_integer_)
           str_count(paste(readLines(f, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8"), collapse = " "), "\\S+")
         }),
         words_per_min = words / (seconds / 60))
for (cd in cfg$conds) rec_info[[paste0("aligned_", cd)]] <- rec_info$rec %in% c(rec_sets_study[[cd]], rec_sets_ext[[cd]])
rec_info <- rec_info %>% mutate(aligned_all4 = rec %in% shared)
success <- map_dfr(cfg$conds, function(cd) {
  a <- rec_info[[paste0("aligned_", cd)]]
  tibble(dictionary = cd, aligned = sum(a), of = length(a), hours_aligned = sum(rec_info$seconds[a]) / 3600,
         median_minutes_failed = median(rec_info$seconds[!a]) / 60, median_minutes_aligned = median(rec_info$seconds[a]) / 60,
         median_words_per_min_failed = median(rec_info$words_per_min[!a], na.rm = TRUE),
         median_words_per_min_aligned = median(rec_info$words_per_min[a], na.rm = TRUE))
})
kable(success, digits = 1, caption = "Alignment success by dictionary, whole corpus")
by_series <- rec_info %>% group_by(series) %>%
  summarise(recordings = n(), minutes = round(sum(seconds) / 60), NigE = sum(aligned_NigE), Indian = sum(aligned_Indian),
            UK = sum(aligned_UK), US = sum(aligned_US), all_four = sum(aligned_all4), .groups = "drop") %>% arrange(desc(minutes))
kable(by_series, caption = "Recordings aligned, by recording series")
by_part <- rec_info %>% group_by(part) %>%
  summarise(recordings = n(), hours = sum(seconds) / 3600, NigE = sum(aligned_NigE), Indian = sum(aligned_Indian), UK = sum(aligned_UK),
            US = sum(aligned_US), all_four = sum(aligned_all4), hours_all_four = sum(seconds[aligned_all4]) / 3600, .groups = "drop")
kable(by_part, digits = 2, caption = "Recordings aligned, by transcription round")
write_csv(rec_info, file.path(out_dir, "corpus_recordings.csv"))
write_csv(success, file.path(out_dir, "alignment_success.csv"))
add_check("Recordings in the corpus", nrow(rec_info), 131, 0)
for (cd in cfg$conds) add_check(paste("Recordings aligned, whole corpus,", cd), sum(rec_info[[paste0("aligned_", cd)]]), c(NigE = 96, Indian = 92, UK = 92, US = 90)[[cd]], 0)
```

```{r corpus-agreement}
agree_pairs <- function(recs) {
  map_dfr(recs, function(rec) {
    a <- read_phones("NigE", rec); a <- a[is_vowel(a$label) & a$end > a$start, ]
    map_dfr(cfg$conds[-1], function(cd) {
      b <- read_phones(cd, rec); b <- b[is_vowel(b$label) & b$end > b$start, ]
      j <- match_best(a$start, a$end, b$start, b$end)
      tibble(rec = rec, part = unname(part_of[rec]), series = str_extract(rec, "^[A-Za-z]+"), cond = cd, nige = a$label,
             other = as.character(ifelse(is.na(j), NA_character_, b$label[j])))
    })
  })
}
agree_all <- agree_pairs(shared)
agree_sum <- function(d) {
  f <- !is.na(d$other)
  tibble(nige_vowels = nrow(d), found = 100 * mean(f),
         same_symbol = 100 * mean(d$other[f] == d$nige[f]),
         same_no_length = 100 * mean(sub("ː+$", "", d$other[f]) == sub("ː+$", "", d$nige[f])),
         same_category = 100 * mean(category(d$other[f]) == category(d$nige[f])),
         mono_to_diph = 100 * mean(d$other[f] %in% DIPH & !(d$nige[f] %in% DIPH)))
}
agree_tab <- agree_all %>% group_by(cond) %>% group_modify(~ agree_sum(.x)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(cond = factor(cond, levels = cfg$conds[-1])) %>% arrange(cond)
kable(agree_tab, digits = 1, caption = "NigE alignment versus each other dictionary, whole corpus: share of NigE vowels found, and agreement among those found")
write_csv(agree_tab, file.path(out_dir, "agreement_between_dictionaries.csv"))
agree_part <- agree_all %>% group_by(part, cond) %>% group_modify(~ agree_sum(.x)) %>% ungroup()
kable(agree_part, digits = 1, caption = "The same, by transcription round (the two rounds should behave alike)")
agree_series <- agree_all %>% group_by(series, cond) %>% group_modify(~ agree_sum(.x)) %>% ungroup() %>% filter(nige_vowels >= 300)
kable(agree_series, digits = 1, caption = "The same, by recording series")
# per recording, so that long recordings do not decide the result: the median across recordings
agree_rec <- agree_all %>% group_by(cond, rec) %>% group_modify(~ agree_sum(.x)) %>% ungroup() %>% group_by(cond) %>%
  summarise(recordings = n(), median_found = median(found), median_same_category = median(same_category), .groups = "drop")
kable(agree_rec, digits = 1, caption = "Median across recordings (each recording counts once)")
top_labels <- agree_all %>% count(nige, sort = TRUE) %>% filter(n >= 300) %>% pull(nige)
agree_label <- agree_all %>% filter(nige %in% top_labels) %>% mutate(vowel = nige) %>% group_by(vowel, cond) %>% group_modify(~ agree_sum(.x)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  select(vowel, cond, nige_vowels, found, same_category) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = cond, values_from = c(found, same_category))
kable(agree_label, digits = 0, caption = "By NigE vowel: share found and share in the same category, per dictionary")
write_csv(agree_label, file.path(out_dir, "agreement_between_dictionaries_by_vowel.csv"))
```

# 5. Reliability (Section 2.3)

This section runs when the files exist: the second annotator's file, the glide-check file and the first annotator's repeat. Each is compared with the first annotator's marks for the same tokens (`id`).

```{r reliability}
locate <- function(f) {
  cand <- c(file.path(cfg$ann_dir, f), p("blind_sample_v2", f))
  cand <- cand[file.exists(cand)]
  if (length(cand)) cand[1] else NA_character_
}
read_other <- function(path) {
  read_tsv(path, col_types = cols(.default = col_character()), progress = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(str_trim(.x) %in% c("?", "--undefined--"), NA_character_, .x))) %>%
    transmute(id, lab2 = canon_label(str_trim(label)), on2 = as.numeric(onset_s), off2 = as.numeric(offset_s)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(lab2), lab2 != "UNSURE", !is.na(on2), !is.na(off2))
}
compare_annot <- function(fname, set) {
  path <- locate(fname)
  if (is.na(path)) { message("Not found yet: ", fname); return(NULL) }
  d <- inner_join(read_other(path), toks %>% select(id, lab, on, off), by = "id")
  tibble(set = set, n = nrow(d),
         same_label_pct       = 100 * mean(d$lab == d$lab2),
         same_ignoring_length = 100 * mean(sub("ː+$", "", d$lab) == sub("ː+$", "", d$lab2)),
         same_category_pct    = 100 * mean(category(d$lab) == category(d$lab2)),
         same_glide_status    = 100 * mean((d$lab %in% DIPH) == (d$lab2 %in% DIPH)),
         median_abs_onset_ms  = 1000 * median(abs(d$on - d$on2)), median_abs_offset_ms = 1000 * median(abs(d$off - d$off2)),
         within5_pct  = 100 * mean(abs(d$on - d$on2) <= .005 & abs(d$off - d$off2) <= .005),
         within10_pct = 100 * mean(abs(d$on - d$on2) <= .010 & abs(d$off - d$off2) <= .010),
         within20_pct = 100 * mean(abs(d$on - d$on2) <= .020 & abs(d$off - d$off2) <= .020))
}
rel <- bind_rows(compare_annot("reliability_second_annotator_annotated.tsv", "Second annotator"),
                 compare_annot("reliability_glide_check_annotated.tsv", "Second annotator, glide-check rows"),
                 compare_annot("reliability_self_repeat_annotated.tsv", "First annotator, repeat"))
if (nrow(rel) > 0) { print(kable(rel, digits = 1, caption = "Agreement with the first annotator's marks")); write_csv(rel, file.path(out_dir, "reliability.csv")) } else
  cat("No reliability files found yet. Save the annotated .tsv files in", cfg$ann_dir, "and knit again.\n")
```

# 6. Verification

## 6.1 Headline numbers against the manuscript

Every row is a number printed in the manuscript. `ok` allows for rounding (and, for bootstrap quantities, for resampling noise). The formant numbers after Table 7 depend on the corrected token filter (`min_span`), so they are not listed here: compare them with the values you report once the document has run.

```{r verify}
chk <- bind_rows(checks)
print(kable(chk %>% mutate(result = ifelse(ok, "PASS", "FAIL")) %>% select(check, got, expected, result),
            caption = "Reproduction of the manuscript's numbers"))
cat(sum(chk$ok), "of", nrow(chk), "checks pass.\n")
if (any(!chk$ok)) cat("Failing checks:\n", paste0(" - ", chk$check[!chk$ok], collapse = "\n"), "\n")
```

## 6.2 Token-by-token comparison with the Python scores

The scores in the manuscript were first computed in Python (`score_blind_sample.py`, `MATCH=overlap`). If that output is available, this chunk compares it with the scores computed above, row by row.

```{r python-check}
py_path <- c(p("blind_sample_v2", "results_overlap", "token_level_scores.csv"), p("blind_sample_v2", "results", "token_level_scores.csv"))
py_path <- py_path[file.exists(py_path)][1]
if (!is.na(py_path) && cfg$match_rule == "overlap") {
  py <- read_csv(py_path, col_types = cols(.default = col_character())) %>%
    transmute(id, cond, model_py = model, detected_py = as.integer(detected), strict_py = as.integer(strict),
              nolen_py = as.integer(nolen), cat_py = as.integer(cat), mono2diph_py = as.integer(mono2diph),
              on_err_py = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(on_err)), off_err_py = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(off_err)))
  cmp <- inner_join(scored, py, by = c("id", "cond"))
  cmp_tab <- tibble(rows_compared = nrow(cmp), rows_in_R = nrow(scored), rows_in_python = nrow(py),
                    detected_equal_pct = 100 * mean(cmp$detected == cmp$detected_py),
                    strict_equal_pct   = 100 * mean(cmp$strict == cmp$strict_py),
                    nolen_equal_pct    = 100 * mean(cmp$nolen == cmp$nolen_py),
                    category_equal_pct = 100 * mean(cmp$cat == cmp$cat_py),
                    model_label_equal_pct = 100 * mean(cmp$model == cmp$model_py),
                    max_abs_onset_diff_ms = max(abs(cmp$on_err - cmp$on_err_py), na.rm = TRUE),
                    max_abs_offset_diff_ms = max(abs(cmp$off_err - cmp$off_err_py), na.rm = TRUE))
  print(kable(cmp_tab, digits = 3, caption = "R scores compared with the Python scores"))
  print(cmp %>% filter(detected != detected_py | strict != strict_py | cat != cat_py | model != model_py) %>%
          select(id, cond, file, lab, model, model_py, detected, detected_py) %>% head(15) %>% as.data.frame())
} else cat("No Python token_level_scores.csv found, or match_rule is not 'overlap': comparison skipped.\n")
```
